items.title: Where Will Broadcom Stock Be in 5 Years?
items.summary: Broadcom is unlikely to match the performance of the previous five years, but that does not mean investors should dismiss it.

items.title: McDonald’s Increased Its Dividend by Nearly 4%. How to Play MCD Stock Here.
items.summary: McDonald’s recently raised its quarterly dividend by nearly 4% to $1.93, marking its 50th consecutive year of dividend growth.

items.title: 3 Companies With a Strong History of Dividend Growth
items.summary: Several stocks with a strong history of increasing payouts - Broadcom (AVGO), ExxonMobil (XOM), and Caterpillar (CAT) - are strong options for those looking to reap income.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Falls. It Has a Google AI Chip Conundrum.
items.summary: A familiar problem is haunting  Nvidia  The chip maker’s stock has paused in its latest effort to break out to new highs—and part of the problem is Google.  Nvidia shares closed down 1.4% at $225.51 on Wednesday.  The biggest threat is  Alphabet’s  Google and its Tensor Processing Units, designed in collaboration with  Broadcom  Although Nvidia and Google’s rivalry is generally an amicable one, investors keep a close eye on which chips the biggest players use.

items.title: Marvell Stock Ran, But Did It Tell You When?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock has returned 248% since September 22, 2025, against about 18% for the S&P 500 over the same window. The products that drove that run were named in public months before the share price moved. None came with a date.

items.title: Broadcom Just Made a Move That Further Solidifies My Decision to Buy on Repeat
items.summary: Broadcom's latest earnings dropped a set of forward projections so aggressive that ignoring them starts to feel like a mistake. Here is why one investor keeps adding shares on every single paycheck.

items.title: AMD Just Joined the $1 Trillion Club as Chip and AI Stocks Rallied. What This Means for Investors.
items.summary: AMD briefly joined the $1 trillion club on Sept. 21 as shares surged nearly 10% to a record above $616, making it the fourth U.S. chipmaker to reach that mark.

items.title: What Changed In AMD's Story?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has stopped leading with the problem that opened its call a year ago. That problem was keeping one of its accelerators out of China. The latest call was fiscal Q2 2026. This time, management did not lead with the subject at all. So what was AMD leading with back then.
